description: Searches the user's own Nock workspace (not the web) for a company, a person or a subject, read-only, across everything at once: people in campaigns (status, last send, reply), campaigns, sheets (by name or a row that mentions it), signals, the company documents and saved memories. Answers questions about something by name ("tudo sobre a Acme", "o que aconteceu com o Marcos", "o que a gente já falou de escolas") in one search instead of listing campaigns or sheets one by one. Free.

query.description: The name or subject, in the user's words.

name: brain_lookup
title: Procurar no workspace
